articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Quadrotor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel adaptive sliding mode control scheme is designed for quadrotor. The sliding mode functions for attitude subsystem and position subsystem are given, and the adaptive law is proposed considering the external disturbances. Meanwhile, this paper views the quadrotor as a variable-mass model, so the adaptive law is also designed for the mass of quadrotor. A rigorous stability analysis of the control method is provided in the sense of Lyapunov stability theorem under given conditions. A dual closed-loop PID controller is introduced and made to compare with adaptive sliding mode controller. The comparative simulations are conducted based on MATALB, the experimental results showing that the proposed control method can provide better flight control performance and improve robustness of the system despite external disturbances.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm for Quadrotor UAV Formation with Input Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of actuator saturation, trajectory tracking, formation and obstacle avoidance planning in multi-UAVs formation obstacle avoidance control, an anti-saturation UAV formation obstacle avoidance control strategy is proposed. First, for the trajectory tracking problem of a single UAV, a backstepping control strategy is used to reduce the second-order nonlinear system to two first-order subsystems to reduce the system complexity. At the same time, a saturation function is designed to eliminate the impact of actuator saturation on the system; On this basis, the formation consistency protocol is designed to ensure the effectiveness of formation control and the corresponding obstacle avoidance function is designed to enable UAV formation to effectively avoid obstacles and ensure flight safety; Finally, the feasibility of the control strategy is verified in the Simulink simulation environment.

articleTitle: Design of Global TT&C of Manned Spacecraft Based on Beidou Short Message System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In addition to providing positioning, navigation and timing services, the Beidou Global Navigation Satellite System can realize global and regional short message communication function. Global tracking, telemetry and command (TT&C) of manned spacecraft based on Beidou short message is of great significance to manned spacecraft. Based on the analysis of the distribution characteristics and service capability of Beidou satellite, a real-time TT&C scheme of manned spacecraft telemetry, positioning data and astronaut short message is proposed. At the same time, the frame format of short message data is designed. Then the TT&C coverage support capability and link characteristic of Beidou system are analyzed. Finally, the method is tested on the ground and verified by the manned spacecraft in orbit. It is proved that the method can meet the global full-time TT&C requirements of manned spacecraft.

articleTitle: Fluid-structural interaction of dielectric elastic membrane airfoil
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The flexible wing provides better maneuverability and efficiency in the low Reynolds number flow from the bioinspiration. A dielectric elastic membrane airfoil for active flow control is proposed. The aero-electro-structural coupling model is established using CFD/CSD coupling technique and verified. The results show that the lift of the dielectric elastic membrane airfoil is 12.33% higher than that of the rigid airfoil at angle of attack 14°, and the contribution ratio of the camber effect and vibration to the lift enhancement is 3:2.

articleTitle: Template Database Based ACARS Air-Ground Data Link Message Parsing Method and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: With the continuous development of the aviation industry, air-ground data link communication equipment has become a piece of mandatory equipment for aircraft. According to the problem that aircraft send ACARS messages with different formats and complex message types, the message parsing logic is summarized by analyzing the ACARS communication system and messages to achieve fast and accurate parsing of message information by building a message template library. By implementing the data link ground system through this process, it is verified that the method effectively improves the readability of message data and can cope with the problems arising from the expansion of message formats such as new models and new parameters, which is of significance to the design work of aircraft democratic manufacturers.

articleTitle: Numerical Research on Discharge Coefficient of Central Wing Box of Aircraft Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Based on the geometric structure of the center wing box of the aircraft, and air is used as the working medium, and the numerical simulation of the discharge coefficient of the center wing box of the aircraft is carried out by using the finite element method and the k-ε turbulence model. Compared with the experiment, the feasibility and accuracy of the numerical simulation are verified, and the calculation results show that there is a recirculation zone in the sudden expansion of the central wing box, and there is a valley and a peak in the pressure along the way. By calculating the effect of different outlet back pressures, different inlet and outlet pressure differences, different lengths of inclined vertical sides of flow channels, and different lengths of inclined horizontal sides of flow channels on the discharge coefficient. The results show that the larger the outlet back pressure, the larger the pressure difference between the inlet and outlet, the smaller the length of the inclined vertical side of the flow channel, the smaller the length of the inclined horizontal side of the flow channel, the larger the discharge coefficient.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Extravehicular Experiments Support System for Manned Spacecrafts
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology, the demand for experiments in space is increasing, and the number of extravehicular experiments carried out by spacecraft is also increasing gradually. Manned spacecraft is an ideal platform for extravehicular experiment because of its large size, strong carrying capacity and human participation. In this paper, according to the requirements of extravehicular experiment, comprehensive support capability and technical characteristics of large manned spacecraft, a design method of extravehicular experiment support system is proposed, and the design or simulation analysis methods of eliminating manipulator operating error, wireless network system extravehicular layout and thermal control support capability analysis are presented. The extravehicular experiment support system can work in collaboration with the space manipulator and replace the extravehicular payload on orbit without astronaut extravehicular activity, which improves the resource utilization efficiency of the spacecraft.

articleTitle: Research on Active Micro Vibration Control Strategy Based on Variable Step FxLMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The demand for in-orbit micro-vibration suppression in high-precision and high-stability spacecraft is becoming increasingly stringent. Active micro-vibration control technologies with higher accuracy are gradually being applied to high-precision and high-stability spacecraft. An active control law was implemented based on the variable step size FxLMS (VssFxLMS) algorithm. Based on engineering practice, its shortcomings in parameter identification and control delay were analyzed, and corresponding solutions were proposed. The automatic calculation and update of the variable step size were achieved based on the mean root square of the error signal, achieving adaptive adjustment of the steady-state convergence step size in the tracking and steady-state stages. Therefore, a set of active micro-vibration control strategies based on the VssFxLMS algorithm was proposed. The effectiveness of this strategy was verified through simulation, and the control effect was analyzed through optical imaging experiments.

articleTitle: Design method of thermal control for micro satellite with integrated structure
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: With the surge in demand for commercial low orbit satellites, thermal control optimization design needs to be carried out from lightweight, automated assembly, and low-cost aspects. This article analyzes the characteristics of micro satellites and proposes a thermal control optimization design method for micro satellites with an open cabin integrated structure. Based on this optimization method, thermal control simulation was conducted on a certain satellite, and the entire satellite equipment was located near room temperature, meeting all equipment temperature index requirements, indicating that this thermal control design method is reasonable and effective. Based on this research result, adopting this method can reduce the use of thermal insulation and thermal conductive external thermal control products, improve the adaptability of automated assembly, shorten the satellite production cycle, and significantly reduce costs.

articleTitle: Spacecraft Role Selection Method Based on Game Trees with Weights
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The uncertain space environment requires spacecraft to have multiple roles and be able to switch between them adaptively. To address the spacecraft role switching problem in space games, this paper proposes a spacecraft role selection method based on a game tree with weights. Firstly, a spacecraft role selection model is established for the spacecraft role switching process, including a space posture threat level model and a spacecraft role switching cost model. Then, the game tree with weights is constructed by considering the space posture threat level and spacecraft role switching cost. Next, the spacecraft role selection method is designed based on the minimax method. Finally, the optimal search depth of the role selection method is analyzed and the effectiveness of the method is verified through game experiments with non-cooperative targets using random and greedy strategies.

articleTitle: Research on Aerial Refueling Pressure Control by Fuzzy PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In view of the poor performance of traditional pressure control for aerial refueling, this paper proposes a pressure control technology for aerial refueling based on speed regulation, and designs a pump regulated refueling pressure control system using fuzzy PID control algorithm. Simulink software is used to build a simulation model of the pressure control system and carry out simulation analysis. At the same time, disturbance is added to the system to test its anti-interference ability. In order to verify the control performance of the fuzzy PID control algorithm, traditional PID and fuzzy PID control algorithms were compared with each other. By analyzing the simulation results, it has been proven that the use of fuzzy control algorithm in the refueling pressure control system based on speed regulation can better achieve the expected control effect.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional path planning of UAV based on SSA and SSO
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm SSA-SO is proposed to solve the path planning problem of UAV when it faces many threats in the mountain environment. Using the parameter setting of the snake swarm algorithm, a fitness function is constructed to compare the accuracy of SO and SSA-SO, simulate the actual scene, set the dangerous area, and obtain the interpolation path according to the optimized nodes. The sparrow search algorithm is divided into early warning and danger awareness, with a ratio of 1:1. Combine these two parts with the snake swarm to update to the new location, and then draw the path obtained by the new algorithm. To evaluate the performance of SSA-SO, MATLAB is used to generate benchmark conditions from a digital model map. The results indicate that in most cases, the proposed SSA-SO is not only superior to the snake optimization algorithm (SO), but also has been tested to prove the effectiveness of the generated path for the real UAV operation.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of aviation safety risk based on PCA and MEST algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: With the continuous development of technology, the relevant technology for flight data recording is constantly updated. QAR overrun data can be used for aviation safety management and flight training data support. Based on the QAR data of a civil airliner in a certain flight segment, this paper aims to conduct dimensionality reduction processing for each index of the QAR data in this flight segment by using principal component analysis method, and analyze the importance of each flight parameter to aircraft safety. Based on the flight data after dimensionality reduction, the Multivariate multivariate algorithm was adopted to Multivariate State Estimation Technique (MSET). Based on the comparison between the aircraft safety parameters actually monitored in the flight segment data and the aircraft health data during normal flight, the alarm threshold of deviation values was set based on the Laida principle. The normal navigation parameters of the aircraft at this moment are calculated and estimated. If the threshold value is exceeded, the automatic alarm is set up.

articleTitle: A comparative study of airspeed calibration using GPS method and tower fly by method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Airspeed calibration is a prerequisite for obtaining accurate airspeed and a basic requirement for airworthiness standards. Due to position error, delay error and instrument error, the measured accuracy of different airspeed calibration methods is different. In this paper, the GPS method and the tower fly-by method are used to calibrate the airspeed of small fixed-wing aircraft, the corresponding data processing methods are established, and the airspeed calibration errors of the two methods are comparatively analyzed, and it is found that the tower fly-by method has smaller position error and better calibration results.

articleTitle: A novel approach to solar sails with high area-to-mass ratios for efficient solar sailing in geospace
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: An ultra lightweight millimeter solar sailing space system named ChipSail was reported in this work. The conceptual design of such a spacecraft includes a chip body and four independent millimeter scale solar sails, which can be built based on Al\NiTi bilayer microstructures. Bending stiffness of each solar sail for geometric maintaining under solar radiation pressure (SRP) in geospace is proven inherently satisfied. Lightweight Microstructures with high area-to-mass ratios show a great potential application in solar sailing. Independent control of each solar sail was demonstrated via the finite element method, which contributed to modelling of forces and moments for orbital maneuvering and attitude adjustment, respectively. A DC voltage of 0.05 V has proven effective for acquiring accelerations up to order of magnitude of 1 mm/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and angular accelerations up to the order of magnitude of 0.1 rad/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. This work provides a promising approach to developing solar sailing spacecraft with an order of magnitude higher solar sail accelerations for geospace exploration.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backstepping Control of Morphing Aircraft Based on RBF Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: To enhance the disturbance rejection of morphing aircraft, an adaptive backstepping control method based on the RBF neural network is proposed. Firstly, the aerodynamic parameters and model parameters are modeled as functions of sweep angle, and the latter is expressed as pure function of time. Then, the RBF neural network adaptive algorithm is combined with the backstepping control to estimate the uncertain disturbance during the wing transition process, so as to compensate for the control law output by the backstepping control. Thereafter, the weight update law of the RBF adaptive algorithm is obtained by Lyapunov stability theory, and the stability of the control system is proved at the same time. Finally, comparative simulation experiments are used to show that the proposed control strategy is preferable, and the error between actual values and the estimated of the RBF adaptive algorithm can be controlled within 0.05%.

articleTitle: Effect of Boundary-layer Bleed System on Radar Stealth and Aerodynamic Performances of S-duct Caret Intake
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: By using the shear stress transport (SST) k-ω turbulence model and the multi-stage fast multipole method (MLFMM) to respectively calculate the viscous flow and the surface current, the radar stealth and aerodynamic performances of the S-duct caret intakes with different boundary-layer bleed (BLB) systems were numerically investigated. Compared with the diffuser bleed system, the throat system more effectively improved the airflow capacity of the traditional S-duct intake with more significant increase in the radar cross section (RCS). By changing the outlet offset direction and using the local bleed system, the average RCS of the new double S-duct intake decreased below - 1.2db and the distortion index DC60 reduced to 0.17, with the total pressure loss slightly increased. The baffle board reduced the stealth performance loss caused by the throat bleed system effectively with the bleed effect ensured. By applying the two bleed system and the baffle board, the airflow capacity of double S-duct intake was significantly improved with the average RCS less than -0.5db and the DC60 of 0.16 at the designed outlet pressure.

articleTitle: Research and design of small GEO communication satellite based on all-electric propulsion platform
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: DFH-3E satellite platform is a small GEO all-electric propulsion satellite platform, which can carry about 20 transponders. It is oriented to small and medium-sized communication capacity demand segment commercial market. Hall electric propulsion system and ion electric propulsion system can be configured on the platform according to different needs of users. The first satellite of the platform is launched by CZ-2C and entered into LEO orbit, which equipped with a separable propulsion segment for rapid orbital ascent, and the satellite adopts "2+2" domestic ion and imported Hall electric propulsion system. Both sets of electric propulsion systems are involved in orbit transfer and in-orbit station keeping tasks. At present, the satellite has completed the Hall orbit transformation task. Through the analysis of the Hall orbit transformation flight results, the effect of the satellite electric propulsion orbit transformation is basically consistent with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Pose Measurement and Modelling Technology of Malfunctioning Spacecraft Based on SLAM
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In order to realize the on-orbit servicing of malfunctioning spacecraft and space debris removal, it is necessary to relative pose measurement and establish the fault model accurately. Aiming at the problem of pose measurement and modeling for non-cooperative malfunctioning spacecraft, a method based on monocular visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) is proposed in this paper. The algorithm is mainly used to extract feature points, match and calculate the pose relation between the camera and the malfunctioning spacecraft, measure the pose change of the malfunctioning spacecraft, and use the relative pose and image sequence to build a three-dimensional model of the malfunctioning spacecraft. The results of ground experiments show that the accuracy of pose measurement and modeling is high, which verifies the feasibility of SLAM technology in the field of on-orbit servicing for non-cooperative target spacecraft.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Calculation for Spacecraft Thermal Models Using a PCE Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Thermal analysis of spacecraft uncertainty is an important part to ensure the robust and reliable design of spacecraft thermal control system. However, the current methods for dealing with this part cannot take into account both accuracy and efficiency. In this paper, the thermal analysis calculation of a spacecraft is used as an example, and a chaotic polynomial expansion (PCE) model is used instead of the original model. The PCE model is used to construct the response relationship between the temperature field and the uncertainty input parameters as a means of analysing the uncertainty information of the temperature field, including statistical information such as mean, standard deviation and probability density distribution. The comparison between the PCE model and the original model uncertainty information shows that the PCE model method has the characteristics of high accuracy and efficiency, which provides a good solution to the problem of calculation accuracy efficiency of spacecraft uncertainty thermal analysis.

articleTitle: Research on simulation method and law of particle damping for solid rocket motor
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: From the perspective of acoustic energy resonance, a numerical calculation method for acoustic energy resonance of particle damping of solid rocket motor was obtained by referring to the steady-state wave attenuation method. The simulation method was verified by comparing with the theoretical calculation results. The effects of particle size, particle concentration, acoustic source intensity and monitoring position on particle damping were investigated. The simulation results are in good agreement with the theoretical calculation results, which shows that this simulation method is effective; The particle damping increases with the concentration increase of condensed phase particles, while forming the stable standing wave in the acoustic cavity, the pressure amplitude decreases. There exists an optimal particle size for particle damping, and particle damping can reach the largest value under the optimal particle size. The acoustic source intensity has little effect on particle damping, and the concentration inconsistency of particles at different monitoring points can lead to different particle damping.

Author Keywords: numerical calculation method for acoustic energy resonance

articleTitle: Analysis of satellite anti-interference performance of direct expansion communication system based on blind source separation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: A blind source separation model based on satellite direct amplification communication system is established to address the interference problem introduced by satellite multipath complex signals. The FastICA algorithm based on negative entropy maximization, the joint diagonalization algorithm based on the fourth-order accumulation matrix and the variable step size adaptive algorithm are used to simulate the anti-interference capability of the direct amplification system. The experimental results show that the blind separation algorithm can effectively separate the overlapping signals, which is feasible for improving the effectiveness and reliability of the satellite direct amplification communication system.

articleTitle: Control Law Design for Aircraft Autopilot Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In this paper, a parameter tuning method based on Particle Swarm Optimization which is used for optimizing the parameters of aircraft flight control system is proposed. To test the validity of this method, simulations on autopilot pitch flight control system are performed. Based on the simulink of Matlab, a model of the pitch flight control system of autopilot is build. Then a fitness function containing domain of time and frequency response of the system is defined, and the domain of time and frequency response is properly weighted according to the requirement of rapidity and stability. The particle swarm optimization method is used in the optimization of autopilot controllers so that automatic tuning of the autopilot controlling parameters can be achieved. Numerical simulations show that the algorithm is effective and has excellent performance, and it was tested valuable for engineering application.

articleTitle: A fast heat transfer calculation and optimization method for solid rocket motor overcoat structure based on Python
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The overcoat structure is located between the solid rocket motor case and the propellant grain, which is an important structural component of the solid rocket motor. It plays an important role in the structural integrity, working reliability and safety of the solid rocket motor. Besides, the thickness of overcoat directly affects the success or failure of solid rocket motor operation, which is the key problem that designers pay attention to. In this paper, a fast heat transfer calculation and optimization method for solid rocket motor overcoat structure based on Python is presented. This method takes into account the typical four-layer structure of case, gas, overcoat and grain, only considering heat transfer between the four layers. The corresponding heat transfer program and graphical user interface are programmed using Python and PyQt15 to realize a fast calculation and optimization of the heat transfer of overcoat structure. Compared with Fluent software, the method is simple and effective, can quickly and accurately predict the heat transfer process of the overcoat structure, which provides great convenience for the design and optimization of the overcoat structure of solid rocket motor.

articleTitle: Design of Space Link IP Network Protocol based on USLP
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Aimed at the requirement for efficient data transmission among space-ground, inter-satellite, and intra-satellite networks, this paper proposes a new onboard integrated information network protocol stack. The Space Link Subnet protocol adopts layered model, including Physical Layer, Data Link Layer, Network Layer, Transport Layer, and Application Layer, which integrates CCSDS and TCP/IP protocols to realize the compatibility of communication protocols between Ground Link Subnet and Onboard Link Subnet. The development of Unified Space Data Link Protocol for all heterogeneous space links targeted for mixed transmission of multiple types of data. The Network Layer uses Encapsulation Packet and IP over CCSDS protocol to carries IP Packet, which realizes global unified IP addressing and data routing service. The Application Layer adopts the Space Packet protocol to realize the interoperability between the application program interfaces of different onboard equipment. The space-ground and inter-satellite communication scenarios are simulated in the ground test system, and the space link network protocol stack and data transmission service proposed in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: Control law design for localizer pre-capture based on integrated navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: To enhance the performance of automatic landing systems for commercial aircraft, a control law of localizer pre-capture was developed based on the maximum pitch angle limit of the approach, the characteristics of the aircraft and localizer, and the fusion signals of the integrated navigation are used to delineate the approach paths and adjust the intercept angle. The modeling and simulation of the control law was implemented using MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results show that the designed control law can guide the aircraft into the linear beam range of the localizer with appropriate intercept angle in various complex situations. The proposed method can provide a reference for further research of automatic flight control system for commercial aircraft.

articleTitle: Multi-Spacecraft Formation Attitude Coordinated Control with Communication Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to manage the attitude of spacecraft formation systems facing persistent communication delays. Communication delays can significantly impact the performance of attitude control systems. To tackle this issue, the proposed algorithm introduces an innovative technique that utilizes the theory of double-exponential control to accelerate the convergence of auxiliary variables constructed based on system errors. This approach effectively reduces the impact of communication delays and ensures stable attitude control. To establish the stability of the system, a Lyapunov-Krasovskii function is employed to derive stability conditions. Simulations are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm is highly effective in managing the attitude of spacecraft formation systems.

articleTitle: Analytical Solution of State Variables Based on Balanced Glide Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In this paper, the relationship expressions between state variables such as flight speed, flight inclination, flight distance and altitude of hypersonic aircraft under equilibrium state conditions are studied, and the analytical solutions of each parameter are solved based on the obtained expressions, and relevant simulation experiments are carried out to verify. The results show that under the condition of balanced gliding, the analytical solutions of state variables such as flight speed, flight inclination, flight distance and altitude can be obtained well based on formula derivation.

articleTitle: Thrust Parameter Identification for Orbital Climbing of Continuous Thrust Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the dynamic characteristics of a continuous thrust spacecraft, the variation of its orbit radius during orbital climb is studied, and the process of orbital climb is described in a formulaic manner, followed by identification of its thrust parameters. Firstly, describe the basic problem of orbital climb, analyze the spatial coordinate system and radar visibility characteristics; Secondly, formula derivation was carried out, and the transformation between spatial coordinate systems and the McLaughlin expansion of orbit radius were carried out; Finally, experimental simulations were designed to verify the accuracy of the proposed thrust parameter identification method. Using the LM algorithm, the solution accuracy can reach 1.5%.

articleTitle: Semi-physical simulation of ADRC flight control system for flying wing UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Based on the ADRC control theory, a semi-physical simulation system for ADRC control system of flying wing UAV with high aspect ratio was established in this study. The flight control performance of attitude and altitude was verified on its typical flight profile, and the nonlinear flight control performance under typical flight conditions in full envelope was evaluated. Some boundary flight conditions and typical interference are tested and analyzed whether the UAV can fly safely. The results of the semi-physical simulation show that the ADRC flight controller has good control performance and robustness in continuous flight in the full envelope with uncertainty of aerodynamic parameters and strong wind interference.

articleTitle: Simulation study on internal flow characteristics of a helicopter fuel ejector pump
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: In order to improve the working characteristics and efficiency of a helicopter fuel ejector pump, on the basis of analyzing the principle of ejector pump to transfer aviation fuel, fluid simulation software was used to simulate it, and compared with the experimental results. The reliability of the simulation method is verified, and then the working characteristics and efficiency of the ejector pump under different operating conditions (pressure ratio) and different structural parameters (throat distance coefficient A, contraction Angle α, diffusion Angle β) are studied. It is concluded that the efficiency of the ejector pump first increases and then decreases with the increase of the pressure ratio. There is an optimal pressure ratio, and the optimal throat distance coefficient is about 1.5. The optimal contraction Angle is about 30°, and the optimal diffusion Angle is about 6°, it provides a reference for the design and optimization of a helicopter ejector pump.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the influence law of adhesive process on electromagnetic attenuation of aerospace devices
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The electromagnetic protection of aerospace devices has received great attention due to the complex electromagnetic environment in space. In order to study the influence of adhesive process parameters on the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) performance of aerospace devices, finite element simulation software CST was used to obtain the influence law of the waveform of narrow-band high-power microwave excitation, the shape of interface connection, the relative position, and the kinds of adhesive material on electromagnetic attenuation coefficient. The numerical simulation results show that the rectangular connection and the adhesive doped with silver powder has the best shielding effectiveness (SE). The study can provide reference for the adhesive process design for obtaining excellent electromagnetic SE of devices.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of launch vehicle based on sequential neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Traditional fault diagnosis technology or a single defect diagnostic approach cannot match the actual needs of specific and sophisticated large-scale systems such as launch rockets. The wide application of artificial intelligence technology provides a new means for fault diagnosis of complex large-scale systems. Combining the test data and fault diagnosis experience accumulated in the aerospace range with artificial intelligence technology has important significance and practical value for the optimization of the efficiency and accuracy of carrier rocket fault diagnosis. According to the requirements of fault diagnosis in the launch vehicle test and launch process, based on the analysis of the existing fault diagnosis methods in the launch vehicle test and launch process, a fault diagnosis method based on sequential neural network is proposed in this paper. The diagnosis approach is validated by using real-world measured data, demonstrating the validity of the fault diagnosis system’s architecture.

articleTitle: Influence analysis of design parameters of low orbit early warning system based on STK/Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: The detection capability of space-based early warning system is closely related to the configuration of satellite constellation and is an important evaluation index that plays a decisive role. Aiming at the problem of early warning deployment and global coverage, the calculation model of early warning system deployment and global coverage under different parameters is established by means of the interconnection of STK and Matlab, and the simulation and numerical calculation of deployment problems are carried out in combination with the actual situation, and the restrictive relationship between the design concept of low-orbit early warning system and global coverage is analyzed. It provides some reference for the design of global early warning system.

articleTitle: Galileo receiver based GPS receiver modification
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite Systems have become an essential technology for positioning, navigation, and timing applications. Currently, the most widely used one is GPS. Based on the concept of GPS, Europe also published their own GNSS system called Galileo which provides better positioning accuracy and availability than GPS. As a consequence, there is an urge for Galileo receivers. This paper provides a description of the modifications to a GPS receiver needed for a Galileo receiver. Because of similar system architectures, a Galileo receiver can be modified from an existing GPS receiver by adding Galileo-capable front ends (antenna) for signal reception and firmware (software) for signal processing, which is very cost-effective and rapid.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Multi-constraint Flight Test Optimization System
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Flight test affects entire life cycle of aircraft and is very important to the development of civil aviation industry. At present, civil aviation industry faces both challenges root in urgency and complexity of flight test. It is of practical significance to study the top-level planning method of flight test tasks and to balance the efficiency and safety of flight test activities under complex constraints. Aiming at the problem of flight test task planning, this paper analyzed its complexity characteristics, established corresponding multi-constraint model, defined the multi-constraint flight test optimization system, and designed its internal function module. The performance of developed system was discussed based on concrete example and proved to be effective and trustworthy.

articleTitle: A Review of the Optimization and Improvement Direction of BeiDou Satellite Navigation System Receiver
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: China has developed an independent satellite navigation system called BeiDou, which has become one of the 4 GNSS systems in the world. The receiver is a key component of the BeiDou system, and optimizing and improving its performance is crucial for ensuring stable operation and wide application. This paper provides a review of current optimization and improvement directions for BeiDou receivers, including a comprehensive optimization process, identifying shortcomings in current receivers, suggesting optimization directions, and discussing the use and maintenance of BeiDou GNSS receivers. This review aims to promote further research and development of BeiDou GNSS system receivers. Additionally, this paper will propose modifications to the GPS reception so that it can receive BeiDou signals.

articleTitle: Considering the cooperative guidance law of multiple vehicles in detection configuration
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: For the missing relative distance guidance problem, a cooperative guidance law for multiple vehicles considering the detection configuration is proposed. Firstly, for the missing relative distance problem, the relative distance is obtained by introducing the cooperative detection of multiple interceptors, and secondly, considering that the detection configuration of interceptors affects the detection error, the guidance law introduces a cooperative ranging error model related to the line of sight separation angle of two interceptors, and adopts the optimal control theory to design an optimal guidance law that can modulate the line of sight separation angle of two interceptors, which can separate the trajectories of two vehicles to increase their It can separate the trajectories of the two vehicles and increase their line-of-sight separation angles to reduce the two interceptors' cooperative detection errors. After Monte Carlo simulation, the proposed guidance estimation method is compared with the traditional guidance estimation method, and the results show that the proposed guidance estimation method has obvious advantages in detection and interception performance compared with the traditional method.

articleTitle: Initial orbit determination method of maneuvering target based on prior knowledge
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: A method of determining the initial orbit of the maneuvering target based on the prior knowledge of orbit maneuver-ing ability was proposed in order to address the issue of a significant error in determining the semi-major axis of the too short arc initial orbit of the space target after maneuvering. Initially, the in-orbit operation of the space target was pro-cessed and analyzed using TLE historical data, and the change rate of the Kepler orbit root number was utilized as an index of orbital maneuvering capability to determine the maximum maneuvering capability in the past. Prior knowledge is transformed into a penalty term in the least squares objective function during the first orbit selection process, and the target orbit's maneuverability is employed to restrict the outcomes. The approach is validated using TLE data from the Cosmos-2542 spacecraft that was made available by SpaceTrack, Matlab, and STK software. According to the findings of a Monte Carlo simulation, a semi-major axis orbit may be accurately determined for a 30 second optical observation arc, and the Laplace-least squares method's deviation decreased by roughly 93%.

articleTitle: Establishment and solution of a pure azimuth passive positioning model in different formation flights of UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: Currently, the cooperative passive positioning of UAVs is developing rapidly and has become the mainstream positioning method for UAVs nowadays. This paper focuses on the modeling establishment and algorithm solving of the UAV passive positioning problem. For the problem of how to determine the position information of each UAV in circular and rhombic UAV formations and how to adjust them to the ideal trajectory, an ideal passive triangular positioning model, a target optimal planning model based on iterative adjustment in the ideal direction and a rhombic passive 3D positioning adjustment model are established, and through the establishment and solution of these models, the positioning and position of UAVs under different circumstances are solved By building and solving these models, we solve the UAV positioning and position adjustment problems under different situations.

articleTitle: Study on Smooth Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Navigation of Quadrotor UAVs in 3D Space for Enhanced Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 2nd International Symposium on Aerospace Engineering and Systems (ISAES)
abstract: For the flight of autonomous navigation quadrotor UAV, non-smooth paths can lead to rapid rotation or flip of the UAV, which causes problems such as target loss and low detection accuracy. In this paper, combining the kinematic and dynamics models of quadrotor UAV in 3D flight, path planning searches for smooth and smooth trajectories to improve the accuracy of target recognition. The improved Hybrid A* algorithm is applied to the 3D path search of the front-end of the quadrotor UAV. The back end performs nonlinear optimization and smoothing of the trajectory generated by the front-end, and the position, velocity, acceleration and angular velocity of each path point of the path planning are nonlinearly optimized to obtain a smooth, robust and safe trajectory. By improving the robustness of the thrust acting on the UAV, the accuracy of the UAV target identification, detection and reconnaissance is ultimately improved. Compared to the fast planner algorithm, the robustness of the UAV fast flight is improved, the smoothness of the path is increased by a factor of 1.1, the target identification accuracy is increased by a factor of 1.15, and the number of missing targets is reduced by 50%. By improving the heuristic function of Hybrid A* and nonlinear optimization of control points at the back end, the quadrotor UAV is able to fly smoothly and stably and improve the accuracy of target recognition.to identify relevant articles in literature searches, great care should be taken in constructing both.
